## 실행

```
bin/payout run 20261005                    # extract → build → ship
bin/payout manifest 20261005               # 그날 전송 CLI에 넘긴 파일과 접수 번호
bin/payout receipts P001 20261001 20261007 # 파트너가 실제로 내려받을 수 있는 일자별 건수·금액
bin/payout partners                        # 활성 파트너
```

스케줄러는 매일 07:00에 전날 일자로 `bin/payout run`을 돌리고, exit 0이 아니면 당직에게 알린다.
`XFERQ_HOME`(전송 CLI 스풀 디렉터리)은 스케줄러 환경에서 지정한다. 벤더 사용법은 `vendor/bin/xferq --help`.

|------|------|
| `bin/payout` | 진입점. 서브커맨드 분기, 단계 순차 실행 |

# receipts.sh — what the partner can actually download, per settlement day.
# Reads the partner's box through the transfer CLI and totals the detail rows.

# receipts_rows PARTNER — one line per header and per detail row of every file
# in the partner's box:
#   P<TAB>date<TAB>part<TAB>parts
#   D<TAB>date<TAB>net
receipts_rows() {
  local partner=$1 name bytes ticket
  xfer_ls "$partner" | while IFS=$'\t' read -r name bytes ticket; do
    [ -n "$name" ] || continue
    xfer_pull "$partner" "$name" | tr -d '\r' | awk -F, '
      $1 == "H" { split($5, pp, "/"); print "P\t" $4 "\t" pp[1] "\t" pp[2] }
      $1 == "D" { print "D\t" $3 "\t" $6 }'
  done
}

# receipts_day ROWS DATE -> "<count> <net>" for the day.
# A split day is totalled only once parts 1..n are all in the box; until then
# the answer is "0 0", the same as a day with no file at all.
# TODO: 일부 파트만 온 날도 온 만큼은 세어 주면 되지 않나? 지금은 '-'라 헷갈린다.
receipts_day() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk -F'\t' -v d="$2" '
    $1 == "P" && $2 == d { seen[$3 + 0] = 1; want = $4 + 0 }
    $1 == "D" && $2 == d { n++; s += $3 }
    END {
      have = 0
      for (p in seen) if (p >= 1 && p <= want) have++
      if (want == 0 || have < want) { print "0 0"; exit }
      print n + 0, s + 0
    }'
}

# receipts_report PARTNER FROM TO
receipts_report() {
  local partner=$1 from=$2 to=$3 rows d cnt net
  rows=$(receipts_rows "$partner")
  printf '# partner %s  %s..%s\n' "$partner" "$(date_dash "$from")" "$(date_dash "$to")"
  for d in $(date_range "$from" "$to"); do
    read -r cnt net <<< "$(receipts_day "$rows" "$d")"
    if [ "$cnt" -eq 0 ]; then
      printf '%s  %4s  %15s\n' "$(date_dash "$d")" "-" "-"
    else
      printf '%s  %4d  %15s\n' "$(date_dash "$d")" "$cnt" "$(money_fmt "$net")"
    fi
  done
}

# naming.sh — remote file names for settlement files.
#
#   HBP_SETTLE_<partner>_<YYYYMMDD>.csv          one file for the day
#   HBP_SETTLE_<partner>_<YYYYMMDD>-<n>.csv      day split into several parts
#
# The transfer service parks (never delivers) names with four or more '_',
# so the part number must not add another '_' field.

# settle_name PARTNER DATE PART PARTS
settle_name() {
  local partner=$1 date=$2 part=$3 parts=$4
  local base="${FILE_PREFIX}_${partner}_${date}"
  if [ "$parts" -gt 1 ]; then
    base="${base}-${part}"
  fi
  printf '%s.%s' "$base" "$FILE_EXT"
}
# manifest.sh — local record of what was handed to the transfer CLI.
# One line per file: date|partner|name|ticket|rows

manifest_file() { printf '%s/manifest.psv' "$OUT_DIR"; }

manifest_add() {
  ensure_dir "$OUT_DIR"
  printf '%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" >> "$(manifest_file)"
}

# A re-run of the same day appends new lines; keep only the latest line for
# each (date, partner, name).
manifest_compact() {
  local f tmp
  f=$(manifest_file)
  [ -f "$f" ] || return 0
  tmp="$f.tmp"
  awk -F'|' '{ k = $1 "|" $2 "|" $3; if (!(k in last)) order[++n] = k; last[k] = $0 }
             END { for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) print last[order[i]] }' "$f" > "$tmp" \
    && mv -f "$tmp" "$f"
}

# manifest_show DATE — the day's lines, partner order.
manifest_show() {
  local f
  f=$(manifest_file)
  [ -f "$f" ] || return 0
  awk -F'|' -v d="$1" '$1 == d' "$f" | sort -t'|' -k2,2 -k3,3
}
# money.sh — integer KRW arithmetic and formatting.

# money_net AMOUNT FEE -> amount minus fee
money_net() { printf '%d' $(( 10#$1 - 10#$2 )); }

# money_fmt N -> "1,234,567"
money_fmt() {
  local n=$1 sign="" out=""
  case "$n" in -*) sign="-"; n=${n#-} ;; esac
  while [ ${#n} -gt 3 ]; do
    out=",${n: -3}$out"
    n=${n:0:${#n}-3}
  done
  printf '%s%s%s' "$sign" "$n" "$out"
}

# naming.sh — remote file names for settlement files.

#   HBP_SETTLE_<partner>_<YYYYMMDD>-<n>.csv      day split into several parts
#

# so the part number must not add another '_' field.

# settle_name PARTNER DATE PART PARTS
settle_name() {
  local partner=$1 date=$2 part=$3 parts=$4
  local base="${FILE_PREFIX}_${partner}_${date}"
  if [ "$parts" -gt 1 ]; then
    base="${base}-${part}"
  fi
  printf '%s.%s' "$base" "$FILE_EXT"
}
# manifest.sh — local record of what was handed to the transfer CLI.
# One line per file: date|partner|name|ticket|rows

manifest_file() { printf '%s/manifest.psv' "$OUT_DIR"; }

manifest_add() {
  ensure_dir "$OUT_DIR"
  printf '%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" >> "$(manifest_file)"
}

# each (date, partner, name).
manifest_compact() {
  local f tmp
  f=$(manifest_file)
  [ -f "$f" ] || return 0
  tmp="$f.tmp"
  awk -F'|' '{ k = $1 "|" $2 "|" $3; if (!(k in last)) order[++n] = k; last[k] = $0 }
             END { for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) print last[order[i]] }' "$f" > "$tmp" \
    && mv -f "$tmp" "$f"

money_fmt() {
  local n=$1 sign="" out=""
  case "$n" in -*) sign="-"; n=${n#-} ;; esac

# Reads the partner's box through the transfer CLI and totals the detail rows.

# receipts_rows PARTNER — one line per header and per detail row of every file
# in the partner's box:
#   P<TAB>date<TAB>part<TAB>parts
#   D<TAB>date<TAB>net
receipts_rows() {
  local partner=$1 name bytes ticket
  xfer_ls "$partner" | while IFS=$'\t' read -r name bytes ticket; do
    [ -n "$name" ] || continue
    xfer_pull "$partner" "$name" | tr -d '\r' | awk -F, '
      $1 == "H" { split($5, pp, "/"); print "P\t" $4 "\t" pp[1] "\t" pp[2] }
      $1 == "D" { print "D\t" $3 "\t" $6 }'
  done
}

# receipts_day ROWS DATE -> "<count> <net>" for the day.
# A split day is totalled only once parts 1..n are all in the box; until then
# the answer is "0 0", the same as a day with no file at all.
# TODO: 일부 파트만 온 날도 온 만큼은 세어 주면 되지 않나? 지금은 '-'라 헷갈린다.
receipts_day() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk -F'\t' -v d="$2" '
    $1 == "P" && $2 == d { seen[$3 + 0] = 1; want = $4 + 0 }
    $1 == "D" && $2 == d { n++; s += $3 }
    END {
      have = 0
      for (p in seen) if (p >= 1 && p <= want) have++
      if (want == 0 || have < want) { print "0 0"; exit }
      print n + 0, s + 0
    }'
}

# receipts_report PARTNER FROM TO
receipts_report() {
  local partner=$1 from=$2 to=$3 rows d cnt net
  rows=$(receipts_rows "$partner")
  printf '# partner %s  %s..%s\n' "$partner" "$(date_dash "$from")" "$(date_dash "$to")"
  for d in $(date_range "$from" "$to"); do
    read -r cnt net <<< "$(receipts_day "$rows" "$d")"
    if [ "$cnt" -eq 0 ]; then
      printf '%s  %4s  %15s\n' "$(date_dash "$d")" "-" "-"
    else
      printf '%s  %4d  %15s\n' "$(date_dash "$d")" "$cnt" "$(money_fmt "$net")"
    fi
  done
}
